rationale: Steven is building TinyHumans AI, a personal AI agent with brain-inspired memory systems prioritizing privacy and local inference, while Artem specializes in efficient inference optimization and open-source LLM tooling at Osmosis AI—his work on real-time VLM inference and transformer acceleration directly complements the performance and accessibility challenges Steven's consumer-first product will face. Both share conviction that open-source efficiency and making frontier models faster matters more than relying on proprietary APIs, and Artem's hands-on infrastructure skills in PyTorch and quantization could unlock the local, private-by-default architecture Steven is pursuing.
intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet Artem Yatsenko — Artem's deep expertise in efficient inference and real-time model optimization at Osmosis AI could be valuable as you scale TinyHumans AI's brain-inspired memory systems toward privacy-preserving local deployment.
